form.name: Name

form.slugHint: Tools show up for agents as {name}.
form.connectionDescription: Where the server runs and how Abotica reaches it.
form.authDescription: How Abotica signs in to the server.
form.authHeadersHint: No auth, or a token in a header

form.authSuggest: This server seems to use OAuth.
form.headerCount: {count, plural, =0 {No authentication} one {# header} other {# headers}}

form.lastSeen: {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}} at the last connection
form.assignmentDescription: Agents get the tools directly or through the projects they belong to.
form.activeHint: When disabled, agents no longer connect to it.
form.deleteCardDescription: Agents lose the tools of this server. This cannot be undone.
form.deleteDescription: It is also removed from every assignment.
form.builtinConnectionDescription: Set up by Abotica and updated with it, so it cannot be edited.
form.globalHint: Every agent gets its tools without an assignment. An agent can still turn it off in its permissions.
form.globalOn: Every agent gets this server. To keep it from one agent, set it to Deny in that agent's permissions.
form.workspaceDescription: The workspace container the process runs in.
form.workspaceServerHint: One process shared by every agent, with its own files.
form.workspaceRunHint: It can read the agent's files in /workspace and saves its own where the agent can read them, but never changes the agent's files. Each project gets its own process.

oauth.title: Authorization
oauth.disconnectedBody: Agents cannot use this server until you authorize Abotica. You sign in on the server page and come back here.
oauth.errorBody: The authorization expired or was revoked. Connect again to restore access.
oauth.afterSave: Saving takes you to the authorization page.
oauth.afterSaveReconnect: Saving drops the current authorization and takes you to the authorization page.
oauth.disconnectDescription: Abotica forgets the tokens and the registered client. Agents lose the tools of this server until you connect again.
oauth.advancedHint: Leave empty and Abotica registers itself automatically (dynamic client registration). Fill in only for servers that require an OAuth app created by hand, with this redirect URI:
oauth.scopeHint: Separated by spaces. Empty: the default scopes of the server.

returned.denied: The authorization was denied on the server.
returned.expired: The authorization took too long or was already used. Press Connect to try again.
returned.failed: The authorization could not be completed.
returned.expiredList: The authorization expired before it was completed. Open the server and press Connect again.

keyValue.hiddenValueHint: The saved value stays as it is. Values that reference a vault secret are shown; any other value is hidden once saved.

testResult.connected: Connected: {count, plural, one {# tool} other {# tools}}

errors.oauthSaveFirst: Save the server and connect it before testing OAuth.
errors.oauthHttpOnly: OAuth is available only for saved HTTP servers set to OAuth.

errors.notBuiltin: This is not a built-in server
